title: The invertible-module pullback locus is closed
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] such that, for every morphism $g:T\to S$, with base change $p:X_T=X\times_ST\to T$ [def-pc-base-change], the canonical map $\mathcal O_T\to p_*\mathcal O_{X_T}$ is an isomorphism. Let $\mathcal E$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] on $X$, and let $j:Z\to S$ be the immersion given by [lem-sc-picard-diagonal-locally-closed] for $f$ and $\mathcal E$ (determined up to unique isomorphism by its universal property). If moreover the geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] of $f$ are integral, then $j$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].

lean.statement: theorem picard_locus_closed {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsInvertible] {Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ S) (hj : IsImmersion j ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation j ∧ QuasiCompact j ∧ QuasiSeparated j ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), (∃ (h : T ⟶ Z), h ≫ j = g) ↔ ∃ (N : T.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree), Nonempty (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E) ≅ ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N))) [GeometricallyIntegral f] : IsClosedImmersion j

reviewed_lean.note: f flat/proper/LFP (proper gives qc+qs = fp, as C1); hO = C1 unit-of-Classical.choose tensorPullbackAdjunction form; E invertible = recorded IsInvertible; j bound with C1's full conclusion verbatim (immersion, LFP, QC, QS, factorization iff with finite locally free N via tensorPullback fst/snd) = 'the j given by C1 up to unique iso'; geometric fibres integral = Mathlib GeometricallyIntegral (all field points, equiv. to algebraically closed residue fields, nonempty included as in Stacks integral; same form as landed GeneralTheoremOfCube); conclusion IsClosedImmersion j; names checked with pp.fullNames #check; docstring has blueprint tag and 0BF0 proof
